task.title: Task page: keep the description on screen while the sidebar scrolls
task.description: Reverses a decision from the task form UI tweaks (PR #203), which let the whole Edit Task page scroll as one page. The form on a task's page should be held to the visible window the way the New Task form is: the description stays on screen, the sidebar scrolls inside the form, and Save stays in view. The earlier cap was removed because it was computed from a fixed estimate of the header height and broke when the app header stacked or the title wrapped, so the cap must come from the real layout rather than an estimate. The thread and change log still follow below the form.
